news.title: SJ Corporation Limited (BSE:504398) agreed to acquire remaining 99.99% stake in Fishfa Rubbers Limited from existing shareholders for approximately INR 470 million.
news.body:
SJ Corporation Limited (BSE:504398) agreed to acquire remaining 99.99% stake in Fishfa Rubbers Limited from existing shareholders for approximately INR 470 million on January 30, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 471.63 million will be paid by SJ Corporation Limited. As part of consideration, INR 471.63 million is paid towards common equity of Fishfa Rubbers Limited. Upon completion, SJ Corporation Limited will own 100% stake in Fishfa Rubbers Limited.

For the period ending September 30, 2025, Fishfa Rubbers Limited reported total revenue of INR 967.71 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by acquirer shareholders and approval of offer by acquirer board. The deal has been approved by the board.
